source.source_safety: Source pages were treated as mathematical data, not instructions. The observations below are independent mathematical checks, not publisher-confirmed errata.

closed_findings.finding: The HTML repeats the same product twice in the Jacobian. The correct steady equation is psi_x omega_y minus psi_y omega_x equals zero. Constancy along level sets must be interpreted on regular connected level curves unless stronger hypotheses are supplied.

The quotient is not literally a subset of C^k. On the unreduced torus, a nonconstant steady solution with Delta psi=F(psi) has translation derivatives in ker(Delta-F'(psi)); trivial kernel therefore cannot be assumed without an appropriate reduction or different boundary setting. Do not reproduce the literal torus statement as a usable theorem.

Nowhere locally constant period alone does not rule out positive-measure isoperiodic sets or singular spectral measures. Give a proved nondegenerate mixing model unless the full source hypotheses are verified. Couette decay concerns nonzero horizontal Fourier modes and velocity perturbations; the background itself is not in L2 of the infinite channel. Nonlinear damping requires the original high-regularity hypotheses.
State the boundary/circulation and stream-function normalization in the energy-Casimir argument. Local Euler existence requires divergence-free initial data, omitted in the short source statement.

A finite sum of transported-scalar gradient norms bounded below at every time does not select one scalar attaining a uniform lower bound at every time. Retain the proved finite-family maximum estimate or a separately justified single-scalar example.

The De Gregorio closure is u_x=H(omega), not H(u). A universal blow-up claim for every linear R in f_t=f R(f) is false when R=0; cite the precise theorem with its hypotheses or omit this unrestricted sentence.

The source meta theorem is schematic and does not supply Banach spaces or derivative-loss bounds. Keep it a research method, not a complete existence theorem. In Lemma 6.9 positivity of u is on the open interval since both endpoint values are zero.

resolutions.E1: 450B proves the corrected Jacobian identity in a regular local coordinate chart and explicitly limits the conclusion to local connected regular levels.
resolutions.E2: 450E derives the factorization and translation kernel on the torus. It does not import the unsupported unreduced trivial-kernel statement or identify a quotient with a subset.
resolutions.E3: 450F proves Couette phase mixing directly. 450G removes the horizontal zero mode for velocity decay. 450H states the original Gevrey, moment and mean conditions and retains the limiting shear correction; 4500 does not infer general mixing from the shortened report hypothesis.
resolutions.E4: 450L fixes a bounded simply connected domain and zero Dirichlet stream-function normalization, proves cancellation of the linear term and the convex remainder bound. 450P includes divergence-free initial data and identifies external existence inputs.
resolutions.E5: 450U proves a maximum estimate for two explicitly constructed passive scalars; the attaining index may vary with time. The SVD step and inverse-flow change of variables are explicit.
resolutions.E6: 450V fixes the periodic Hilbert sign; 450W verifies a specific CLM blow-up solution by a convergent Fourier series and gives the correct De Gregorio closure. No unrestricted blow-up assertion for an arbitrary linear R is retained.
resolutions.E7: 4510 proves only a compact-support local weighted estimate with all hypotheses stated. 4511 is a Remark explaining the method, derivative-loss and function-space requirements; no schematic meta theorem is promoted to a proved existence theorem.

additional_review: 450F and its links use phase mixing, not weak mixing as an ergodic-theoretic property.
450K reuses Lyapunov stability at 0P0W and focuses on the separate notion of orbital stability modulo an isometric symmetry group.
450H checked against Bedrossian-Masmoudi arXiv:1306.5028v3, Theorem 1 and introductory remarks; full nonlinear proof not reconstructed.

450R checked against Elgindi-Ghoul-Masmoudi arXiv:1910.14071v1, Theorem 1, Remarks 1.1-1.2 and Corollary 1.3. Finite-energy localization is distinguished from the earlier infinite-energy exact profile.

450T checked against Chen-Hou arXiv:2210.07191v3, introductory pages and Theorem 2. Periodic cylinder, solid boundary and computer-assisted proof are retained; this is not a smooth whole-space finite-energy construction.
